programs.title: Black Friday
programs.desc: After the 1993 Mumbai bomb blasts rip the city apart, the police force launches a massive drive to catch the perpetrators. Their relentless pressure finally results in some names coming forward.

programs.title: Phir Hera Pheri
programs.desc: The lives of three men changes overnight when they lose all the money they invested in a scam. Now, they must find another way to repay the dreaded loan sharks or face their death.

programs.title: The Stoneman Murders
programs.desc: Mumbai of 1980s is terrorised by a serial killer who ruthlessly kills pavement dwellers in their sleep. A suspended police officer then decides to step in and conduct an investigation.

programs.title: I, Me Aur Main
programs.desc: Aarush, Al and Tanmay, three womanisers get the shock of their life when they find a baby girl at their doorstep claiming to be the daughter of one of them. As they try to find her mother, they discover an unexplored side of their own personality.

programs.title: Bollywood Movie
programs.desc: The Movie Club +2 broadcasts Bollywood and popular Indian cinema on a two-hour time-shifted delay, allowing viewers to catch missed movies on India's free ad-supported streaming platforms.
